schema_version.description: Version of this schema used by the runtime.

evidence_refs.description: References to selected Evidence Packet records.

constraint_refs.description: References to selected runtime, policy, or task constraints.

token_budget.description: Budget metadata for compiling this working set.

provenance.description: Source and version metadata for included working-set references.

omitted_context_notes.description: Important known omissions or exclusions that may affect verification, recovery, or evaluation.
